stop_condition: Done when the corrected wording has been checked once for accuracy (neither over- nor under-claiming), the negative control has been checked once for a reintroduction shape it would miss, and behaviour-invariance has been checked once; then either a finding at or above high, or verdict=approve with findings=[]. BOUNDED: no exhaustive proof of absence. The five anti-overreach outcomes must not move.

findings.evidence: Both source and runtime negative checks use the same finite pattern `tamper-evident|tamper evident|unforgeable|cannot be forged|proof that`. The equivalent false claim `This provenance-authenticated record can only be produced by qa-gate.sh approve.` produces zero matches. It can be appended while retaining all required OMISSION/STALENESS/FORGERY text, so every positive assertion and both negative checks still pass.
findings.description: The paired negative control does not reliably fail when the forgery-resistance claim returns under an unlisted synonym. This defeats the task's central regression requirement and permits the operator-facing block to become self-contradictory again.
